# data.docker_image_search

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Searches Docker Hub (or the registry named in `term`) through the daemon, like `docker search` (`GET /images/search`). Results are in the registry's order; the provider's `registry_auth` for that registry is sent.

| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |
| `is_official` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Only official images (`true`) or only non-official ones (`false`) (`--filter is-official`). |
| `limit` | `number` | optional |  |  | Maximum number of results (`--limit`), 1 to 100. Default: the registry's (25 on Docker Hub). |
| `names` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | Repository names found, in result order. |
| `results` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | The GET /images/search response as a nested object, field by field. |

| `stars` | `number` | optional |  |  | Only images with at least this many stars (`--filter stars`). |

## Example

```terraform
# Search Docker Hub through the daemon (docker search).
data "docker_image_search" "redis" {
  term        = "redis"
  limit       = 10
  is_official = true
}

output "official_redis" {
  value = data.docker_image_search.redis.names
}
```
